key_claims: Saudi Arabia is a key financial base for al-Qa'ida and other terrorist groups.
Most terrorist money from Saudi Arabia originates from wealthy individuals, fundraisers soliciting smaller donations, and diversions from NGOs.
Part of al-Qa'ida's income derives from legitimate religious contributions where donors are unwitting, misled or look the other way.
Some fundraisers knowingly donate to al-Qa'ida and know the money finances terrorist activity.
Since 9/11 Riyadh has acted on US requests, and with donors' fear of US/international action, money flowing to al-Qa'ida has dropped.
SAMA oversees Saudi banks' freezing and seizing of terrorist-linked assets.
Tens of millions of dollars of Saudi donations remain a concern, and targeting donors, fundraisers, banks and NGOs is key.
